content:
Apple today released a fun new ad promoting the new Mac mini with the M6 chip. Apple also released a short behind-the-scenes video showing the (significant) effort that went into making the ad. Watch below.

"We had to hand carve and create everything"

Apple's @helloapple Instagram account today posted a short Instagram Reels showing part of the process behind the fun ad for the new Mac mini (M6).

In the video (shared by MacMagazine), animators Justin Rasch and Scott DaRos, along with art director Josh Mahan, show sketches, props, sculptures, techniques and materials used in the production, timelapse footage of stop-motion animation, and behind-the-scenes footage revealing how multiple ad animations were completed.

While the ad isn't quite as wild as the TikTok promotional campaign for the MacBook Neo since Apple launched this entry-level laptop, it's still pretty fun, especially when you see how much practical craftsmanship went into it.
